# terminal-a11y

> Terminal accessibility enhancement layer (screen-reader, photophobia, sensory-budget, braille, audio-progress). By Paul Kirby.

- Repo: https://github.com/markkirby125/terminal-a11y
- Install: git clone https://github.com/markkirby125/terminal-a11y.git && pip install .
- Part of Vision Apps: https://github.com/markkirby125/vision-apps
